startIntroPart1: You lead the Eternal Pact, a civilization bound by an ancient covenant of immortality. Your warriors cannot be destroyed by mortal weapons — yet their oath forbids them from striking down the weak. They endure. They wait. They watch.
startIntroPart2: When your scholars unlock the secrets of Engineering, the covenant will be fulfilled and your guardians will ascend. Until then, hold your ground and let no enemy break what cannot be broken.
declaringWar: The Pact has been broken. Our guardians march.
attacked: You strike at the unkillable. This will not end well for you.
defeated: The Pact... is no more. Our guardians have finally fallen.
introduction: We are the Eternal Pact. We have outlasted empires. We will outlast you.
tradeRequest: The Pact trades only when it benefits the covenant.

startIntroPart1: You command the Undying Order, a brotherhood forged in deathless fire. Your soldiers have walked battlefields for centuries, yet no blade has ever claimed them. Their endurance is their gift — and their burden.
startIntroPart2: The Order does not expand through settlement. It expands through conquest. When Engineering reveals the pinnacle of your craft, a new champion will rise and the world will bend.
attacked: You cannot kill what does not die.
defeated: The Order... falls. We did not think it possible.
introduction: The Undying Order stands before you. Choose your next words carefully.
hateHello: We remember every slight. Every one.
tradeRequest: The Order will trade — but we do not forget debts.

startIntroPart1: You are the voice of the Deathless Legion, soldiers who have transcended mortality itself. They march without fear, for death holds no power over them. Their weakness is not in their bodies — it is in their restraint.
startIntroPart2: The Legion expands by taking, not by building. Survive the early age on the strength of your immortal warriors, and when Engineering dawns, unleash the full fury of what your Legion truly is.
declaringWar: The Legion advances. Stand aside or be crushed.
attacked: Foolish. You cannot wound what will not die.
defeated: The Legion is broken. We never imagined this day.
introduction: The Deathless Legion does not negotiate from weakness. Remember that.
hateHello: You have earned the Legion's attention. Not a good thing.
tradeRequest: The Legion will trade. Do not mistake this for friendship.
